findings.evidence: The added kernel already uses the real exponent `a - n - 1`; the same shift works with `q : ℝ`. TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/Pareto.lean uses the analogous natural-level API `integrable_rpow_paretoMeasure_iff` and `integral_rpow_paretoMeasure` for real exponents.
findings.fix: Prove the core results for `q : ℝ` using `Real.rpow`, with threshold `q < a`, and derive natural-power specializations if those are useful.
findings.issue: `integrable_inv_pow_gammaMeasure_iff` and `integral_inv_pow_gammaMeasure` restrict the exponent to `n : ℕ`; consequently `integrable_pow_inverseGammaMeasure_iff` and `integral_pow_inverseGammaMeasure` at InverseGamma.lean:329 and :339 expose only natural moments, omitting valid fractional and negative real moments.

summary: The moment API is unnecessarily restricted to natural exponents even though the proof and established distribution conventions support the natural real-power result.
